attempts.name: r1
attempts.outcome: Native source execution exposed that SPIN-COUNT returns the timeout symbol, not zero; JSON writer refused that symbol. Corrected generated return and both independent oracles to preserve native identity. The aborted WITH-OPEN-FILE deleted its incomplete native.json; only its diagnostic and original source survive.

attempts.name: r2
attempts.outcome: Corrected native oracle and seven generated modules compiled. Browser acquisition was added on user direction; this preliminary compile lacked that extra case.

attempts.name: r3
attempts.outcome: Real browser input and all native cases passed; Node execution reached the oracle but the portable assertion compared JSON object insertion order. Replaced it with recursive structural comparison. The failed source and log are retained.

attempts.name: r4
attempts.outcome: Reused compiled r3 artifacts with corrected assertion; complete Node execution passed.

attempts.name: r5
attempts.outcome: Fresh compile, native, Node and browser execution passed. The minimum-instead-of-maximum clamp fault refused at state assertion before the intended semantic oracle. Replaced it with a valid but wrong 999 clamp to isolate the semantic difference.

attempts.name: r6
attempts.outcome: Reused passing r5 positives; all twelve execution faults and ten publication controls rejected at their focused diagnostics.

attempts.name: r7
attempts.outcome: Final fresh end-to-end execution, retained before independent replay.

attempts.name: publication-r1
attempts.outcome: Retention named the native.json deleted by the aborted r1 WITH-OPEN-FILE, so it stopped before manifest publication. The subsequent verifier refused the missing manifest. Removed the nonexistent file from the development list; computation unchanged.
